nodes.g: Machbanai = "bond of the Lord" a Gadite and one of David's mighty warriors who joined him…
Mishmannah = "fatness" a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors, who joined him at Ziklag
Othni = "lion of Jehovah" a Levite, son of Shemaiah, the first-born of Obed-edom
Rephael = "healed of God" son of Shemaiah and grandson of Obed-edom
